Theorem
[Null Lagrangians and boundary conditions] ↗ def:null-lagrangian 1. ch8:8.1-thm-1\group Null Lagrangians

Let $L$ be a null Lagrangian. Assume $\mathbf{u}, \bar{\mathbf{u}}$ are two functions in $C^2(U, \R ^m)$ such that \[ \mathbf{u} = \bar{\mathbf{u}} \quad \text{on } \partial U . \tag {18} \] Then \[ I[\mathbf{u}] = I[\bar{\mathbf{u}}] . \tag {19} \]

Proof

\sketch Join two maps with the same trace by the affine path $u_\tau =u+\tau (v-u)$. The first variation of a null Lagrangian vanishes along the path, so the integral is constant in $\tau $.

□
